concept:
Character concept for a 2D cut-out animation game. Draw ONE original creature: a round woolly GOAT KID with twig horns and a daisy crown, the first stage of a three-stage Wood evolution line, in the same view and pose as image 1, crouched low on its belly with its little hooves tucked under, head facing forward, on a plain white background. A cute, chunky creature, but an original design that must look clearly DIFFERENT from the figure the silhouette came from; not any existing character.

Image 1 (grey silhouette) and image 2 (the same figure split into numbered regions) show the PUPPET RIG the new creature will be animated on. They tell you where each part and joint is, NOT what the creature looks like: do not trace their outline. Viewer-left and viewer-right mean as seen in the picture.

KEEP FROM THE RIG (the animation moves these parts around these joints):
- the same parts, no more, no fewer, each where its numbered region is: 1 face; 2 woolly fleece body; 3 two twig horns; 4 daisy crown; 5 three small feet;
- every joint where it is and every part pointing the same way as in image 1; eyes where the old eyes are;
- each part about the size and shape of its region; the whole figure about the same size.

CHANGE (the new look, region by region):
1 face: a wide rounded goat-kid face: chestnut brown with a small pale cream muzzle patch around the nose and mouth, two big honey-amber eyes (one catchlight dot each) exactly where the old eyes are, brows angled down, a small determined grin with a tiny fang.
2 woolly fleece body: fluffy warm cream wool with soft scalloped curls and the same outline: the back fleece, the side tufts and the fringe on top of the face all cream wool; no green, no leaves.
3 two twig horns: two short dark-brown wooden twig horns growing from the same places, one on each side: each a stubby crooked branch with one small fork and one or two tiny fresh light-green leaf buds, pointing outward like the old horns; no curls, no tan.
4 daisy crown: a small crown of three or four yellow daisies with orange-brown centres and a couple of small olive leaves, sitting on top of the head in the same place, about the same size; no pink, no rose.
5 three small feet: three small stubby feet: cream fur with dark-brown hoof tips (a small split-hoof line).

ATTITUDE: a stubborn little goat kid ready to head-butt: brows angled down, a small determined grin with a tiny fang; cute, never scary, never a cheerful mascot.

{RENDER}
{DESIGN}
The style sheet is image 3; the hand-drawn map is image 4. Image 5 is an approved character of this game: copy its ink line weight and its pencil and crayon texture, not its design; it has a few white shine spots and some darker shading: do NOT copy those.

COLOURS: fluffy warm cream wool, a chestnut-brown face with a small pale cream muzzle, dark-brown wooden twig horns with small fresh light-green leaf buds, yellow daisies with orange-brown centres, dark-brown hooves, big honey-amber eyes. Few colours.

AVOID: green or bush-like wool, round curled light-tan ram horns, roses, lilies, pink or pastel-pink flowers, curly yellow-green stamens or antennae, gold armour or gold rings, an all-white or all-cream face, text, labels, numbers, the region colours, frames, background scenery, a second view, shading, shadows, white highlights, glossy shine, glow, gradients.
